title: Generative Models
summary: A personal research repository of PyTorch implementations exploring generative and data-augmentation techniques (GAN, WGAN, CGAN, VAE, CVAE) on image datasets, plus tabular data augmentation experiments comparing SMOTE, CT-GAN, T-VAE and GReaT for minority-class oversampling. Its tabular_data_aug scripts import SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.tabular) with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic minority-class rows for classifier training.
evidence: tabular_data_aug/src/main_TVAE.py:63-67 synthesizer = TVAESynthesizer(metadata, epochs=2000,...); main_CTGAN.py analogous with CTGANSynthesizer
